purpose: Post hoc fully nested sensitivity analysis of the complete L2-penalized logistic-regression pipeline within the 540-patient training set. Does not modify the locked final model.

excluded.note: 136-patient model-selection set and 198-patient external cohort never enter this analysis. External cohort is used only for descriptive comparison with the existing external AUC 0.801 after this analysis completes.

inner_cv.purpose: C tuning and inner-loop selection only

final_model.note: C re-tuned per outer fold; published locked C=0.6672367170464207 NOT used here.

c_grid.selection: max mean inner 5-fold validation AUC; ties within 1e-6 -> smaller C (stronger regularization); boundary hit recorded, grid not expanded

preprocessing_order: 1. median (continuous) / mode (categorical & ordinal & binary) imputation fitted on the current training subset
2. truncation to prespecified clinical bounds (see clinical_bounds_applied)
3. deterministic feature engineering (squares, log1p on clipped values, interactions, recalculated ratios with zero-denominator -> 0.01, composites)
4. RobustScaler on all 42 continuous engineered features: center = subset median, scale = subset IQR, scale = 1.0 if IQR == 0 (e.g. contrast_ml)
5. categorical fixed encodings: tbad_stage 0/1/2, tbad_stratum 0/1/2 (clinical 1/2/3 minus 1); binary 0/1
6. transform validation/test folds with the training-subset parameters

feature_engineering_frozen_definitions.source: Recovered exactly (r^2 = 1 to 1e-12) against stage1_optimized archived RobustScaler-inverted training values, except the two composites as noted

recalculated_ratios.rule: recomputed from imputed components; zero denominators replaced by 0.01

composites.comorbidity_count: hypertension + cad + dm + smoking + alcohol (exact integer match vs archived)
composites.inflammation_score: crp_pre + wbc_pre (documented definition from preprocess_ext_v3.py; exact historical internal formula not byte-recoverable - fixed reproducible definition adopted, NOT tuned to recover any variable set)
composites.surgery_complexity: operation_time_min/60 + stent_count, computed from clipped values (documented definition from preprocess_ext_v3.py; same caveat as inflammation_score)

fdr_univariate_logistic.method: univariate LogisticRegression per engineered feature (Wald p)

lasso_1se.inner_cv: 10-fold stratified on the current training subset
lasso_1se.rule: C_min = argmax mean CV AUC; C_1se = smallest C with mean_AUC >= max - SE(C_min); keep nonzero coefficients at C_1se
lasso_1se.warm_start_path: C-grid fitted in ascending C order with warm_start=True (numerical efficiency only; estimator l1/saga, C grid, 1-SE rule unchanged); final refit at C_1se is a cold start
logging: mean AUC and SE at both

rf_permutation.class_weight_decision: Option A: class_weight=None to match the current manuscript statement that class weighting was used only for XGBoost and LightGBM candidate models
rf_permutation.holdout: 80/20 stratified split of the current training subset with a fixed derived seed
rf_permutation.keep: mean AUC decrease > 0 on the selector holdout

xgb_permutation.holdout: 80/20 stratified split of the current training subset with a fixed derived seed (same split as RF)
xgb_permutation.keep: mean AUC decrease > 0 on the selector holdout

fallbacks.empty_vote: use the single feature with smallest FDR q; record fallback='empty_vote_fdr'
fallbacks.empty_after_vif: keep the feature with most votes and lowest VIF; record fallback='empty_vif_top_vote'

vif.rule: iterative with intercept; recompute until all VIF <= 5; drop max-VIF feature; if a main effect and its square are both candidates, drop the square; if VIF is infinite (perfect collinearity), drop the derived term with the highest mean absolute correlation that is not a clinical main effect; log every removal with before/after VIF
vif.note: Does NOT reuse the old feature_selection_audit.txt core-variable protection; reproduces the automatic VIF rule described in Methods

threshold_for_classification.source: locked threshold from the 136-patient model-selection set; NOT re-optimized in this analysis

bootstrap.rule: resample 540 patients with replacement; retain repeated patients with multiplicity; calculate the 5 repeat-level AUCs separately within each resample and take their mean; 95% CI = 2.5% and 97.5% quantiles of the mean-AUC bootstrap distribution
bootstrap.forbidden: pooling the 2700 repeat-level predictions into one AUC per bootstrap resample or treating them as 2700 independent patients

primary_metric: mean of the 5 repeat-level pooled out-of-fold AUCs
